label: Start of line
description: Matches a position at the beginning of a line.

label: End of line
description: Matches a position at the end of a line.

label: Digit
description: Matches one number character.

label: Non-digit
description: Matches one character that is not a number.

label: Word character
description: Matches one letter, number, or underscore.
matches: u, s, e, r, _, i, d

label: Non-word character
description: Matches one character that is not a letter, number, or underscore.

label: Whitespace
description: Matches one space, tab, or newline.
matches: The space between A and B

label: Non-whitespace
description: Matches one character that is not a space, tab, or newline.

label: Any character
description: Matches any one character except a newline.

label: Zero or more
description: Repeats the previous item zero or more times.

label: One or more
description: Repeats the previous item one or more times.

label: Optional
description: Repeats the previous item zero or one time.

label: Exact count
description: Repeats the previous item exactly three times.

label: Count range
description: Repeats the previous item from two to five times.

label: Capture group
description: Groups part of a match so replacement text can reuse it.

label: Either/or
description: Matches the expression on the left or the right.

label: Character class
description: Matches one character listed inside the brackets.

label: Negated class
description: Matches one character not listed inside the brackets.

label: Word boundary
description: Matches the edge of a word.
matches: cat at the beginning and end with \bcat\b

label: Replacement group 1
description: Uses the first capture group in replacement text.

label: Replacement group 2
description: Uses the second capture group in replacement text.

label: Collapse blank lines
description: Finds three or more newlines and makes large vertical gaps smaller.

label: Trim line-end spaces
description: Finds extra spaces or tabs at the end of each line.

label: Swap date order
description: Finds dates like 2026-09-10 and captures year, month, and day.

label: Numbered list to bullets
description: Finds numbering at the beginning of a line.

label: Find lines containing text
description: Finds whole lines that contain a specific word.

label: Remove blank lines
description: Finds lines that contain only spaces or tabs, then removes the line.

label: Convert tabs to four spaces
description: Finds tab characters so indentation can be made consistent.
